results.title: Installation | Playwright
results.snippet: Playwright enables reliable end-to-end testing for modern web apps. Supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. Created by Microsoft.

results.title: @playwright/test - npm
results.snippet: Playwright Test has 5M+ weekly downloads. Used for browser automation and E2E testing. Startup involves spinning up browser instances.

results.title: microsoft/playwright: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing - GitHub
results.snippet: Playwright supports all modern rendering engines. Cross-language: Node.js, Python, .NET, Java. 65k GitHub stars. Maintained by Microsoft.

results.title: Playwright vs Cypress in 2024: the definitive comparison
results.snippet: Playwright is primarily an E2E testing tool, not a unit test runner. Comparing it to Jest or Vitest is comparing apples and oranges.

results.title: How fast is Playwright for E2E tests?
results.snippet: Playwright startup requires browser launch which adds 1-3 seconds overhead. Not meaningful to compare startup with unit test runners.
